evaluation: Complete frozen 303-event roster; primary original six-model common genuine support, separately matched to LLM sample
training: Original full 198449-row past-window pool used by frozen neural baselines; evaluation restricts 303-event roster
targets: Unchanged true future prices and frozen completeness/freshness masks
time_split: For evaluation month T: train [T-90d,T-30d), validate [T-30d,T); train/val label origin+h*60+60 < window end

lightgbm.parameterization: current exact price plus forecast change
lightgbm.features: 72 current-centered prices, 71 first differences, exact current price, trailing mean/std/min/max over 3/12/36/72 points
lightgbm.selection: per horizon past validation hierarchical MSE; no train+validation refit after selection

autoarima.fit: independent fixed 72-point window at each origin; no future labels
autoarima.optimizer_convergence: record optimizer convergence separately from finite forecast availability

chronos2.point: author API default median (q=.5), not called an expected mean
chronos2.pretraining_time_caveat: pretrained model released after some retrospective evaluation dates; not a contemporaneously available model for all dates

grid_mapping: AutoARIMA/Chronos: h>=5 use exact 5-minute step; h=1 linear interpolate current exact price and next 5-minute model forecast. LightGBM direct all eight horizons.
postprocessing: unchanged support-gated semantic p0+.75*(z-p0)+.25*m, clipped [0,1], then identical complete-vector joint Euclidean logical projection
failure: No current-price fallback; nonfinite/failed predictions explicitly missing; incomplete logical vectors excluded, shared comparison support reaggregated
scoring: original contract -> vid -> original component equal weights, horizon-specific supports; no graph group substitution
inference_dedup: identical numeric histories may reuse identical univariate forecasts, with exact inverse mapping, independent of targets
autoarima_window_preprocessing: Before fitting, subtract window mean and divide by window standard deviation (1 for constant window); invert affine transform before clipping. Uses only the unchanged 72 history values.
autoarima_numerical_recovery: For nonfinite primary forecasts, rerun identical stepwise search with return_valid_fits; choose first finite 288-step forecast in AICc order. If none, same grid with Powell maxiter200. No labels used, no current-price fill. Preserve original successful predictions and original candidate file; save separately finalized array.
